root_cause: The preregistered low-inhibition difference slice [-600,-300] was inside the marginal canonical difference range but was not jointly feasible with excitation values below 300. The sampler then formed a negative upper inhibitory-rate bound below its zero-clipped lower bound.
scope: Pilot input construction only; canonical S1 data, NEURON teacher dynamics, synaptic release and prior model results are unaffected.
disposition: All partial v1 shards are excluded from analysis and must not be merged with the corrected run.

guards: configuration validation rejects any jointly infeasible inhibitory interval
all eight factorial arms are sampled across 32 deterministic seeds in the test suite
